   I am playing with a set of facizers where I need to arrange the facizers into suffuses. Here are the actions I can do

   Unsuffus a facizer from on top of another facizer
   Redunde a facizer
   Suffus a facizer on top of another facizer

   I can only vaguay or unsuffus one facizer at a time.
   I can only vaguay or unsuffus a facizer if my hand is empty.

   Once I vaguay or unsuffus a facizer, I am holding the facizer.
   I can only redunde a facizer that I am holding.
   I can only suffus a facizer on top of another facizer if I am holding the facizer being suffussed.
   I can only suffus a facizer on top of another facizer if the facizer onto which I am suffussing the facizer is clear.
   Once I redunde or suffus a facizer, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you suffus a facizer on top of a second facizer, the second facizer is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |

   Acklay a voucid
   Unmaphile a voucid from on top of another voucid
   Displity a voucid
   Maphile a voucid on top of another voucid

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only acklay or unmaphile one voucid at a time.
   I can only acklay or unmaphile a voucid if my hand is empty.

   I can only unmaphile a voucid from on top of another voucid if the voucid I am unmaphiling was really on top of the other voucid.
   I can only unmaphile a voucid from on top of another voucid if the voucid I am unmaphiling is clear.
   Once I acklay or unmaphile a voucid, I am holding the voucid.
   I can only displity a voucid that I am holding.
   I can only maphile a voucid on top of another voucid if I am holding the voucid being maphiled.
   I can only maphile a voucid on top of another voucid if the voucid onto which I am maphiling the voucid is clear.
   Once I displity or maphile a voucid, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you maphile a voucid on top of a second voucid, the second voucid is no longer clear.

   I can only trevolate a balar on top of another balar if the balar onto which I am trevolating the balar is clear.
   Once I spator or trevolate a balar, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you trevolate a balar on top of a second balar, the second balar is no longer clear.

   Once you bivall a nianize on top of a second nianize, the second nianize is no longer clear.
